releaseNotes.en: Camera Filters are here! Choose between three unique styles to customize your captures. Both File Explorer and Wi-Fi Drop now support direct APK transfers and on-device installation. The Wi-Fi Drop browser interface has been completely revamped with transfer reliability fixes, and Camera UI readability is improved.
releaseNotes.zh: 收紧照片和视频中的 Matrix 效果覆盖范围，加快识别更新。提升 Wi-Fi Drop 文件传输的可靠性，重新设计网页界面，优化手机浏览体验，并支持全部核心语言。点击 APK 文件时会先显示操作菜单，安装完成或失败的结果也会保留显示。
